strings.(시이나가 %s의 모습을 보자마자 상기된 모습으로 달려와 안긴다.): (The moment Shiina spots %s, she rushes over, beaming, and throws her arms around them.)
You haven't changed, Shiina. It's good to see you.
strings.그동안 어떻게 지내셨어요? 소문으로 듣긴 했는데, 그래도 직접 듣고 싶어: How have you been? I've heard the rumors, but I'd love to hear it from you.
strings.(시이나를 만나지 않은 시간 동안 있었던 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (I briefly tell Shiina about everything that happened since we last met.)
strings.그동안 많은 일들을 겪으셨네요. 그걸 또 다 해결하시고. 역시, 모험가님: You've been through so much. And you managed to resolve it all! You're amazing, Adventurer.
strings.다시 뵙고 싶었는데, 이렇게 만날 수 있어서 정말 기뻐요. 언니와는 정말: I've been wanting to see you again, so I'm really glad you're here. You've seen my sister so many times...
Somehow, I've ended up owing Dayna quite a lot.
strings.다름이 아니고 제피로스 이사장님의 부탁이 있어서 제가 대신 메시지를 드리: Actually, Chairman Zephyros asked me to send you a message on his behalf.
strings.이렇게 바로 오신 걸 보니 제 메시지가 제대로 도착했나 봐요. 멀리까지: Since you came so quickly, it must have reached you. I'd never sent wind magic so far before, so I was a little worried.
strings.그랬군요. 클로리스 씨와 제피로스는 어디에 계세요?: I see. Where are Chloris and Zephyros?
They're both in the principal's office. Whatever they're discussing, it's taking a while.
The principal's office is over there. I'll show you the way.
strings.괜찮아요, 시이나. 바로 앞인데요, 뭘. 그런데 왜 이렇게 시끄럽죠?: It's all right, Shiina. It's right there. But what's all that noise?
strings.(학원장실 안에서 격한 대화를 이어가는지 문이 들썩거린다. 시이나가 난처: (The door shakes as a heated conversation rages inside the principal's office. Shiina looks embarrassed, then sighs.)
They're both wonderful, but once they start talking to each other...
That's how siblings are, isn't it?
Now that you're here, I wish they'd stop...
(With a determined look, Shiina opens the office door a crack and tries her own approach.)
strings.언니들, 적당히 안 하면 고모할머님께 갈 거예요!!: If you two don't behave, I'm going to Great-Aunt!!
Yes. She's a wonderful person. Oh, you can go in now.
strings.고마워요, 시이나. 같이 들어갈래요?: Thank you, Shiina. Would you like to come in too?
strings.아니에요. 괜찮아요. 저는 여기서 기다린다고 언니들에게 전해주세요. 지금: No, thank you. Please tell my sisters I'll wait here. I don't really want to see them right now.
I will, Shiina. See you later.
strings.저 %s입니다. 들어가도 될까요?: It's me, %s. May I come in?
strings.(학원제 일 이후로 처음 방문하는 학원장실, 제피로스가 먼저 모험가를 알: (It is the adventurer's first visit to the principal's office since the school festival. Zephyros notices them first and offers a greeting.)
strings.%s 씨, 어서 와요. 안 그래도 기다리고 있었어요. 그러고 보니 학원장: %s, welcome. We've been waiting for you. Come to think of it, this is your first time in the principal's office, isn't it?
No, I came here during the school festival to fight you after you fused with the Windy Seed...
strings.이왕이면 날개 달린 괘종시계도 잊어주겠어? 학생들은 대충 헛것을 본 거라: And while you're at it, could you forget the winged grandfather clock too? Most of the students think they were seeing things. So you're the only one who really saw it, %s...
Right? If only %s hadn't seen it either...
strings.설마, 클로리스 씨…. 절 어떻게 해버리려고 생각하신 건 아니겠죠?: Chloris... You're not thinking of doing something to me, are you?
Chloe, it's written all over your face.
I still see myself looking like that every night. It's killing me.
It'll get easier with time. But those two don't look very happy...
strings.(방금 전 시이나가 했던 말 때문인지 데이나와 카이나의 얼굴에 그림자가: (Perhaps because of Shiina's words just now, Dayna and Kaina both look stricken.)
strings.언니, 시이나가 고모할머님께 가겠다는데…?: Kaina, Shiina said she'd go to Great-Aunt...?
She was probably just saying that... How would she even know where Great-Aunt is...?
She did say she'd get in touch. If Shiina were to tell her something like that...
...I don't even want to imagine it.
strings.고모할머님이 누구시기에 두 분께서 저렇게 떨고 계시는 거죠?: Who is their great-aunt? Why are they both so frightened of her?
Shiina told me she's the only older relative they have left whom they can rely on.
She lives far away and is very busy, so even as children, they didn't see her often.
strings.흐음, 그렇군요. 그나저나 두 분, 이제 괜찮으세요?: Hmm, I see. Anyway, are you two all right now?
strings.(데이나가 정신을 차리고 모험가를 맞이한다.): (Dayna collects herself and greets the adventurer.)
I was too preoccupied to apologize properly then.
We called you all that way, then put you in an awkward position with our family problems. I'm sorry. It wasn't my sister's fault. It was entirely mine...
I'm all right. Please don't worry about it.
I hadn't expected a visit from Your Majesty.
I have something important to discuss.
If Your Majesty has come to tell us in person, it must be serious...
So you both have something important to tell me. Hmm...
You may hear either the chairman or me first. Whichever you prefer.
strings.다시 한번 감사의 인사를 드릴게요. 아이에 섬과 리프트라시르에서 일어났던: Allow me to thank you once again. Thank you for resolving the incidents involving the witches on Aie Island and in Lifthrasir.
strings.%s의 활약에도 불구하고, 모든 일이 끝난 건 아니에요. 아론…. 아론이: Despite your efforts, %s, this isn't over. Aaron... I've learned what Aaron is after.
You said before that he was searching for witches...
strings.오래전, 프레이오스에선 패권을 다투던 전쟁이 일어났었어요. 많은 세력이: Long ago, a war for supremacy swept through Freios. Many powers rose, fell, and vanished.
strings.왕국이었던 실바리아가 패권을 잡으면서 당시 국왕이셨던 시이나 여왕께선 초: When Silvaria, then a kingdom, emerged victorious, its ruler, Queen Shiina, became our first empress.
strings.여기까진 이미 알고 있는 내용이죠, %s?: You know this much already, don't you, %s?
Not in detail, but I know the broad strokes.
strings.인간들은 오래전부터 해를 입히는 존재를 소탕했어요. 그중엔 사나운 동물도: Humans have long hunted down those they considered a threat. Ferocious animals, beasts from the Demon Realm, demons, and witches alike.
strings.당시 의회는 마녀에 집중하기로 하고, 마녀를 잡아들였어요. 그 중엔 진짜: The council of that era chose to focus on witches and began rounding them up. Some of those witches had truly done terrible things... and some had not.
strings.나쁜 짓을 하지 않는 마녀도 있었어?: There were witches who didn't do anything wrong?
Yes. Some simply lived in hiding and harmed no one.
And some of those arrested as witches were ordinary humans.
strings.의회의 권력을 잡고 있는 귀족들을 반대한 세력 사람들이었죠. 반대파는 너: They belonged to factions that opposed the nobles who controlled the council. It became all too easy to brand their opponents as witches, or accuse them of worshipping witches...
They were all killed, weren't they...?
strings.그 이후로, 마녀들이 나타나는 일은 거의 없었어요. 나타나면 누군가에게: After that, witches rarely showed themselves. Any witch who did faced death at someone's hands.
strings.그런 마녀를 의회가 찾기 시작하면서 그때와 같은 이름을 사용했어요. 바로: Now the council has begun seeking witches again, using the same name as before. A...
But they can't simply intend to capture and kill them...
They want something from the witches. Just as witches kill one another and take their power.
strings.다시 나타나서 10년 전의 일을 들먹거리고 날 농락했어. 그리고 그때처럼: He showed up again, taunted me about what happened ten years ago, and toyed with me. I also found evidence that he'd been in contact with a witch, just like back then.
It was probably a coincidence that Barbatos encountered us that day.
A coincidence...? Kaina, don't tell me...
Barbatos never appeared in my visions.
Dayna, I want to tell %s what happened to us ten years ago. Is that all right?
It's all right. We can trust %s with this.
Fifteen years ago, when Shiina was two, our mother died of a chronic illness.
strings.이때다 싶어 의회 소속 귀족들은 국가의 안정을 위해서 새로운 황비의 자리: The council's nobles seized the opportunity. Insisting that the position of empress consort could not remain vacant for the sake of national stability, they put forward daughters from their own houses.
strings.말이 추천이지, 의회에서 정해준 짝으로 아들을 낳고, 후계를 이으라고 강: They called them recommendations, but they were forcing him to marry the council's choice, have a son, and make him heir.
strings.선대 황제들과 달리 아버지께선 황자 시절 몰래 나가 비밀 연애를 하셨고,: Unlike previous emperors, our father had snuck out as a prince and courted someone in secret. Then he brought our mother home and declared, almost as a challenge, that he was going to marry her.
strings.어머니는 몰락 귀족의 외동딸이셨어요. 부와 명예, 권력까지 가지고 있는: Our mother was the only daughter of an impoverished noble house. The council's nobles, with all their wealth, prestige, and power, looked down on her family.
And they looked down on us as her daughters, too.
Even though we were every bit as much members of the imperial family...
strings.아버지께선 어머니께도, 우리에게도 미안할 짓이라면서 의회의 제안을 받아들: Father refused the council's proposal, saying it would betray both our mother and us.
strings.새 황비를 들여 언제 태어날지 모르는 아들보다는 곁에 있는 딸들이 더 나: Rather than marrying again for a son who might never be born, he encouraged the daughters already at his side to dream of a better future.
Then, ten years ago... he was murdered. By Barbatos...
strings.그날, 한 귀족이 용병을 이끌고 황성을 습격했어요. 자격이 없는 자가 황: That day, a noble led a band of mercenaries in an attack on the imperial palace. He declared that someone unworthy must never take the throne...
strings.제 예지 능력이 용병의 발목을 묶었고, 붉은 달의 상처 기사단이 그들을: My foresight held the mercenaries at bay, and the Scar of the Red Moon knights wiped them out. Though there were rather few of them for a rebellion...
strings.아버지는 제 능력을 알고 계셨지만, 드러내지 않으셨어요. 반란군을 소탕하: Father knew about my ability, but kept it secret. He used my visions only to secure a future in which the rebels were defeated.
strings.제가 본 미래 중에는 아버지의 죽음도 있었는데…. 데이나에게 절대 알리지: Among the futures I saw was his death... He told me never to tell Dayna. With our youngest sister to care for as well, he feared it would unsettle her...
strings.바르바토스가 나타났고, 시이나를 데려가려고 했어요. 전에도 마녀가 나타나: Barbatos appeared and tried to take Shiina. A witch had appeared before him, saying that Shiina had to be taken to the black place.
We rescued Shiina with the help of Argent and the other Moon's Scar knights...
strings.어쨌든 마녀가 다른 방법을 찾아보겠다며 아무렇지도 않은 듯 물러났고. 우: Anyway, the witch left as though nothing had happened, saying she'd find another way. We lost consciousness and, for a short time, couldn't remember what had happened...
strings.이번에 성당에서 만난 마녀 맞죠?: The witch you encountered in the cathedral, correct?
strings.그 마녀처럼 바르바토스도 시이나를 제물로 삼아야겠다면서 데려가려고 했어요: Like that witch, Barbatos tried to take Shiina away, saying he needed her as a sacrifice.
First a witch, then a demon... Father tried to protect Shiina from Barbatos. But apart from his title, he was an ordinary human.
strings.우리는 동생을 지킨 대신, 아버지를 지키지 못했어. 약했고, 어리석었어…: We saved our little sister, but we couldn't save Father. We were weak and foolish... He told us it was all right, but...
strings.아버지가 쓰러지고 나서 바르바토스가 마음이 바뀌었는지 시이나를 내려놓았어: After Father fell, Barbatos seemed to change his mind and put Shiina down.
Then... he left, saying we would meet again someday.
strings.그때, 바르바토스는 뭔가를 느낀 것 같았어. 마치 피해야 할 대상이 근처: It felt as though Barbatos sensed something then. As if someone he needed to avoid was nearby...
...I wish Kaina had seen something at the time, but she hadn't...
Very few of the council's nobles know that Barbatos appeared. The council insisted we keep it that way... Ah... I'd rather not remember this...
I understand why you did it, Kaina. But I don't know if it really was the best choice...
That is what happened to us ten years ago.
strings.(다프네와 바르바토스가 시이나를 노렸어. 그리고 다른 방법을 찾아보겠다는: (Daphne and Barbatos both wanted Shiina. And what did Daphne mean by finding another way?)
strings.클로이와 나는 언제나 너에게 고마운 마음을 가지고 있다. 지난 학원제 일: Chloe and I will always be grateful to you. For what you did at the school festival, and now in Crystal Moon Forest...
Please, I didn't do that much...
strings.그리고 미안하다. 이 일에 널 끌어들이는 것 같아서…. 이미 알고 있겠지: And I'm sorry. It feels as though I'm dragging you into this... You already know this, but the Empire's shadows run deep and wide.
strings.모르고 지나갔다면 모른 채로 죄를 지었을 거야. 하지만, 알고 있다면 다: If I'd never found out, I might have sinned in ignorance. But anyone who knew would have made the same choice I did.
My father was a mage, though he preferred to be called a magic researcher.
strings.원래는 현자의 탑에서 뼈를 묻으실 생각이셨지만, 밖으로 나와 독자적으로: He originally intended to spend his life at the Sage's Tower, but he left and continued his research independently.
strings.당시 마법사들 사이에서 마법청의 평판은 그다지 좋지 못했어. 새로운 인재: The Magic Bureau had a poor reputation among mages then. It practically monopolized new talent, and its ties to the council made it a willing servant of power.
strings.아버지께선 마법청에서 요청하는 일을 처리하는 게 싫으셨지만, 경제적 여유: Father hated taking jobs from the Bureau, but we had little money, so he had no choice but to keep doing it.
strings.아마도 10년 전…, 선황 폐하께서 승하하시기 며칠 전…. 아버지께서 마: It was about ten years ago... a few days before the late emperor died. We received word that Father had touched a magical device without permission in the Bureau's warehouse, triggering a surge of magic that killed him...
Someone of Father's skill would never make a mistake like that... Sigh...
strings.가족이라고는 노토스와 나밖에 남지 않은 상황에서 절망하고 있을 때, 우리: Notos and I had no family left but each other. When we were lost in despair, we received a great deal of help.
strings.수도에 있는 기숙학교도 다니고, 마법사의 눈에 띄어서 마법청에 근무할 수: We attended a boarding school in the capital, caught a mage's eye, and even got positions at the Magic Bureau.
For novice mages, it was the opportunity everyone dreamed of.
strings.아무것도 몰랐으니까 그런 게 가능했던 거야. 하지만, 알고 나선 아무것도: We could do all that because we knew nothing. Once we learned the truth, we were powerless.
strings.아버지의 죽음은 사고가 맞아. 하지만, 일어나지 않을 수도 있는 일이었어: My father's death was an accident. But it was an accident that need never have happened. The Magic Bureau's shadows caused it...
strings.아버지는 창고에 있던 재료가 필요한 것뿐이셨어. 창고에 잠들어있던 마도골: Father only needed some materials from the warehouse. He didn't know the magic golem sleeping there would awaken...
A magic golem... Don't tell me...
strings.노토스와 내가 창고에서 마도골렘에 걸려 있던 아버지의 피 묻은 망토 조각: Notos and I found a bloodstained scrap of Father's cloak caught on the golem in that warehouse...
strings.노토스가 더는 마법청에 있을 수 없다 판단해서 항의하러 간 동안, 나는: Notos decided he couldn't stay at the Bureau and went to protest. Meanwhile, I looked for records about the golem.
But they threatened me into silence.
strings.우리 형제가 이 일을 더 깊게 파겠다면, 클로이를 비롯 주위에 있는 모든: If we brothers dug any deeper, they would kill everyone around us. Chloe included.
I had to decide then and there. I chose to become their hostage.
When Notos returned, I picked a fight with him over ridiculous things. Father's death was only an accident, I said. Why should we leave over that...?
strings.그렇게 노토스를 마법청에서 내보냈어. 다음은 클로이…, 클로이에게도 잠수: That was how I drove Notos out of the Magic Bureau. Chloe was next... I disappeared from her life without a word. But I still had to make certain of one thing.
That she couldn't remain at the Bureau either...
strings.결국 모두 떠나고 나서야 나는 내가 생각한 걸 하기로 마음먹었어. 마법청: Only after everyone had left did I finally commit to my plan. I would approach the Bureau's shadows. So I spent five years as its dog.
And I did uncover some of it. The darkness I learned about by turning my back on everyone...
Chloe, I'm all right. Don't look at me like that.
strings.그래도…. 아, 노토스한테는 어떻게 이야기할래?: But... Oh, how are you going to tell Notos?
I'll handle that myself. Thank you for worrying.
strings.(두 사람, 이제 괜찮은 건가…?): (Are things all right between those two now...?)
%s, listen carefully. We're running out of time. And we'll have even more to do.
strings.몇 년 전, 데고스를 저지했던 장소, 기억하지?: You remember where you stopped Degos a few years ago?
The garden nearly became a gateway to the Demon Realm, but you stopped it. Since then, we've discovered several other places that could become gateways too.
strings.내가 파악한 것만 해도 네가 갔었던 로젠가르텐과 바니타스 같은 장소도 있: Among those I learned of were places you've visited, such as Rosengarten and Vanitas.
strings.제피로스, 그곳도 알고 있는 거예요? 마법청은 어디까지 알고 있는 거죠?: Zephyros, you know about those places too? How much does the Magic Bureau know?
I only read the information they compiled. I don't know how they obtained it.
strings.하여튼, 그런 문이 계속해서 나타났다 사라지기를 반복하면서 큰일이 생겼어: In any case, those gateways have kept appearing and disappearing, and it's caused a serious problem.
strings.허공해를 비롯해 프레이오스 서부와 동부 사이에 있는 마력의 소용돌이가 조: The magical whirlwinds between western and eastern Freios, including those in the Void Sea, have begun to settle. Their magic is weakening.
Freios is currently suspended in the sky above the other continents.
strings.잠깐만요…. 이거, 그거잖아요. 대륙을 감싸고 있는 마력의 흐름이 약해지: Wait... That means... If the flow of magic surrounding the continent weakens, Freios will...
strings.여러 조각으로 갈라져 하늘 위로 올라갔던 프레이오스 대륙이 마력이 사라지: The Freios continent broke into pieces and rose into the sky. The moment that magic disappears, those pieces will fall into the seas and onto the other continents of this world.
strings.고위 마법사들은 이런 현상을 느끼고 있었어. 특히 마법청의 간부들은 강하: Powerful mages could sense this happening. The Magic Bureau's leadership must have felt it especially keenly, but they did nothing.
Instead, they devoted themselves to other matters.
strings.고대 마도골렘을 운용하기 위해 사람의 영혼과 감정을 다양한 방법으로 실험: They experimented on human souls and emotions in all sorts of ways to operate an ancient magic golem.
They even created an ancient Creed beastfolk capable of controlling such golems freely. I don't know everything that happened in that laboratory...
strings.지금 그 수인은 마법사를 죽이고 탈출했고, 고대 마도골렘도 데리고 나갔다: But that beastfolk killed a mage and escaped, taking the ancient golem with them. The golem that killed my father...
strings.그 일들이 모두 의회 주도로 이뤄지고 있어. 문과 관련된 일에는 조용하면: The council is behind all of it. They stay silent about the gateways, yet pursue this so eagerly.
strings.그리고 이 일에 관여한 자가 의회의 인물 말고도 더 있는 것 같다. 수인: And I think others besides the council are involved. A witch and a demon helped the beastfolk get out.
strings.복잡하지? 어쩔 수 없었어. 내가 확인할 수 있는 사실은 여기까지야. 좀: Complicated, isn't it? I'm afraid it can't be helped. That's all I've been able to confirm. I need more information...
But Her Majesty and Dayna have offered their help, so we should manage.
strings.그래서 제피로스는 어떻게 되는 거예요? 마법청 비밀 같은 걸 알고 있다면: Then what will happen to you, Zephyros? If you know the Bureau's secrets, surely...
strings.그들도 다 알고 있을 거야. 하지만, 날 내버려 두는 건 쓸모가 있어서겠: They probably know everything I've done. If they're leaving me alone, I must still be useful to them. Though I don't yet know how.
The people at the Magic Bureau... They've already abandoned their humanity...
...Thank you. That must have been hard to talk about...
strings.폐하의 말씀 속에 등장하는 바르바토스라는 마족의 목적은 뭘까요?: What does this demon Barbatos, whom Your Majesty mentioned, want?
Barbatos wants to become the master of this world. A god.
strings.신이요? 마족인데 신이라고요?: A god? But he's a demon!
strings.(클로리스에게 성역에서 바르바토스를 만났던 이야기를 짧게 전한다.): (I briefly tell Chloris about meeting Barbatos at the Sanctuary.)
strings.(%s의 이야기를 듣던 카이나가 작은 소리로 중얼거린다.): (Listening to %s, Kaina murmurs under her breath.)
That explains it... I've never had a clear vision involving Barbatos...
Just talking to myself. Never mind.
Oh, there's something I forgot to mention. About the council...
strings.여러분을 믿고 말씀드리는 거니까, 이건 다른 곳에 이야기가 들어가지 않도: I'm telling you because I trust you. Please keep this between us.
strings.아르젠트가 기사단과 함께 의회 소속 귀족 한 명을 구금했어요. 마족과 만: Argent and the knights have detained one of the council's nobles. They found evidence that he met with a demon.
strings.(사람들이 많은 이야기에 놀라 말을 이어가지 못할 때, 학교 로비 중심에: (As everyone struggles to take in these revelations, the grandfather clock in the school lobby chimes the hour.)
Oh, is it that late already...?
strings.그런데, 언니. 이렇게 자리를 비워도 되는 거야?: By the way, Kaina. Is it all right for you to be away this long?
strings.안 그래도 개인 사정으로 오늘 쉽니다, 하고 날 닮은 인형을 놓고 나왔어: I left a doll that looks like me and a note saying, "Taking the day off for personal reasons."
strings.(카이나가 아무렇지도 않은 듯이 환하게 웃는다.): (Kaina smiles brightly, as though nothing were amiss.)
I'm joking. I made the proper arrangements before leaving.
That wasn't funny, Kaina. Nobody seems to believe you.
It's been a while. Let's have a meal together.
Now? I've got so much that needs doing right away...
All right. If it's what Shiina wants...
Your Majesty? Was there something you wanted to tell me...?
Oh, no. I'll contact you later.
All right. I'll wait to hear from you.
I'll contact you as well when the time comes, Zephyros.
strings.의회와 마법청 간부들은 이미 제피로스가 어떤 마음이고 어떤 행동을 했는지: The council and the Bureau's leadership will already know your intentions and everything you've done.
strings.위험한 순간이 온다면 제가 먼저 알려 드릴게요. 루리아에 계실 곳도 마련: If danger approaches, I'll warn you first. I've also prepared somewhere for you to stay in Luria.
You are most gracious, Your Majesty.
Well... Thank you, Zephyros. You've helped me make up my mind.
We'll take our leave now. Come along, Dayna.
strings.네, 언니! 저 배고파요. 우리 이렇게 다 같이 식사하는 게 얼마 만이죠: Yes, Kaina! I'm hungry. How long has it been since we all ate together like this?
Goodness. How long has it been?
strings.갑자기 미안하다고 하는 거 아니야. 알았지, 데이나?: No apologizing out of nowhere. All right, Dayna?
strings.학원장님, 이사장님. 저 언니들 따라 식사하고 돌아올게요. 외출 허락 해: Principal, Chairman, I'll be back after eating with my sisters. May I have permission to go out?
strings.(세 자매가 떠나자 시끌벅적했던 학원장실이 고요해진다.): (With the three sisters gone, the bustling principal's office falls quiet.)
strings.이제 어떻게 할 셈이야?: What are you going to do now?
strings.노토스를 만나 이야기하려고. …쉽게 이해해줄 거라고 기대는 하지 않지만: Meet Notos and talk to him. ...I don't expect him to understand right away, but still...
strings.(두 사람 사이는 원래대로 돌아간 것 같고…. 이제 나는 뭘 하면 될까…: (Those two seem to be back to normal... What should I do now...?)
strings.(그런데, 기분이 묘하네. 마치 무슨 일이라도 일어날 것 같….): (But something feels strange. As though something is about to hap...)
strings.(그런 그때, 주위의 공기가 바뀌면서 눈앞에서 작고 하얀 구름같은 것이: (Just then, the air changes. A little white cloud appears before the adventurer and smiles.)
strings.(그리고 그 사이에서 낯설지 않은 누군가의 목소리가 들려온다.): (A familiar voice comes from within it.)
strings.(%s 님, 저 아르케예요. 아에루라를 보냈으니까 제 목소리를 듣고 계시: (%s, it's me, Arche. I sent Aerura, so you should be able to hear me now, right?)
strings.(프뉴마에 와주셔야 할 것 같아서요. 문이 발견됐어요. ▒▒▒▒로 가는: (I think you need to come to Pneuma. We've found a door. A path to ▒▒▒▒.)
strings.(아르케, 장소 이름이 잘 들리지 않아요.): (Arche, I couldn't hear the name of the place.)
strings.(아…. 아직인가 보네요. 아무래도 이름이 들리는 걸 허락하지 않나 보네: (Oh... Not yet, then. It seems you still aren't permitted to hear the name.)
strings.(…그곳에 계신 분과 인사하시면 아에루라가 %s 님을 프뉴마로 모시고 올: (...Say goodbye to the people you're with, and Aerura will bring you to Pneuma, %s.)
strings.(제피로스와 클로리스가 허공을 향해 중얼거리고 있는 %s의 모습을 보고는: (Watching %s murmur into thin air, Zephyros and Chloris nod as if they understand.)
(Aerura smiles at Chloris's words, swaying the musical note shape above its head.)
strings.아, 보고 계셨구나. 어? 두 분은 이 아에루라가 보이시나요?: Oh, you were watching. Huh? You can both see Aerura?
strings.그런데 뭐라고 하기에 그렇게 오래 이야기한 거지?: What was it saying to keep you talking so long?
There's somewhere I'm being asked to visit.
strings.(정령이 방문을 부탁한다면 보통 일이 아니겠군….): (If a spirit is asking for a visit, it must be serious...)
strings.역시 %s 씨는 인기가 많네요. 피곤할 텐데 괜찮겠어요? 리프트라시르에서: You're as popular as ever, %s. You must be tired. Will you be all right? You only just returned from Lifthrasir.
I'm all right, Chloris. Let's say goodbye here.
If you say you're all right, I won't worry.
Goodbye, both of you. I'll see you again.
strings.(아에루라를 따라 다시 찾은 프뉴마, 활기찼던 정령들이 평소와는 다르게: (Following Aerura, the adventurer returns to Pneuma. The once-lively spirits are moving unusually slowly.)
strings.아에루라? 방금 전까지 신나게 움직였으면서…. 뭐지?: Aerura? You were so lively a moment ago... What's going on?
strings.(밖에서 모험가를 데리고 온 아에루라도 프뉴마 안으로 들어오자 움직임이: (Aerura, who brought the adventurer here from outside, also slows down upon entering Pneuma.)
strings.저는 괜찮긴 하지만, 정령들에게 조금 문제가 생겼어요. 하지만, 너무 걱: I'm all right, but something's happened to the spirits. Don't worry too much, though. They've only slowed down a little.
strings.크로노스하고 카이로스 일인가요?: Is it something to do with Chronos and Kairos?
No, it isn't. They'll be back to normal soon.
Arche, what's happened? Please tell me.
It's not really a secret... A door suddenly appeared in Pneuma.
I've never seen anything like it since coming to Pneuma.
strings.혹시 어디로 가는지 알아요?: Do you know where it leads?
strings.저는 프뉴마를 떠날 수 없는 몸이라 여러 정령들이 가보겠다고 해서 문 앞: I can't leave Pneuma, so several spirits volunteered to go. But when they reached the door, none could enter.
strings.크로노스와 카이로스조차 다가갈 수 없는 공간…. 프뉴마의 정령조차 막았다: A place even Chronos and Kairos can't approach... If it bars even Pneuma's spirits, that means they haven't been given permission.
I thought you and Iris should know, %s, so I contacted you. I'm keeping watch, and I'll tell you immediately if I notice anything suspicious.
strings.아, 미안해요. 아르케…. 그 문이 어디 있는지 알려줄래요?: Oh, sorry, Arche... Could you show me where the door is?
strings.여기에요. 평범한 길처럼 보이지만, 그 앞에는 보이지 않는 벽이 세워져: Here. It looks like an ordinary path, but there's an invisible wall across it.
strings.(%s의 발걸음이 앞으로 나아가려는 순간, 항상 밝은 빛으로 가득했던 프: (As %s takes a step forward, Pneuma's perpetually bright scenery begins to blur.)
strings.(아르케의 모습이 지우개처럼 흔적도 없이 지워져가고, 어디선가 언젠가 들: (Arche fades away without a trace, as though erased. A voice that seems faintly familiar echoes from somewhere.)
strings.「그대가 이곳에 들어오는 걸 허락하겠다. 하지만, 그대는 그 아이에게 묶: 「I shall permit you to enter. But you are bound to that child. Obtain her permission as well.」
strings.「그러면 빛이 사라진 ▒▒▒▒에 도착할 것이다.」: 「Then you shall arrive in ▒▒▒▒, where the light has died.」
strings.「필멸자여. 그대가 서두르지 않으면 지금 내 손에 있는, 가이아가 아끼는: 「Mortal. Unless you hurry, the soul of Arche, so dear to Gaia, will be consumed here in my hand...」
strings.(그 말이 끝나기 무섭게 프뉴마를 찾아온 어둠은 %s의 모든 걸 삼켜버린: (The moment the voice falls silent, the darkness invading Pneuma swallows %s whole.)
strings.(깊은 어둠은 이내 사라지고, %s에게 다시 따뜻한 빛을 안겨준다. 하지: (The deep darkness soon lifts, returning %s to warm light. But the scene before them is no longer Pneuma.)
strings.아, 그때 그 상처 괜찮아? 괜찮은 거야?: Oh, that wound from before... Are you all right now?
I'm all right. I was going to meet with you and tell you when I had the chance.
But how did you get here? No one should be able to enter right now...
strings.아, 맞아. 나 이러고 있을 때가 아니지. 이리스, 내가 그곳에 갈 수: Oh, right. There's no time for this. Iris, let me go there. Pneuma is in danger.
strings.침착하세요. 그게 무슨 말이죠?: Calm down. What do you mean?
strings.(이리스에게 아르케의 메시지를 받아 프뉴마를 방문했던 이야기를 한다.): (I tell Iris about Arche's message and my visit to Pneuma.)
strings.안 돼요. 프뉴마는 가이아 님을 뵈러 간 곳이지만, 그곳은 인간이 가면: No. You went to Pneuma to meet Gaia, but that other place is somewhere humans must never go. We have no allies there.
strings.비록 제가 그곳을 가보진 못했지만, 알 수 있어요. 빛이 사라져 쓸쓸하고: I've never been there myself, but I can feel it. The light is gone. It's desolate, cold, and terribly lonely.
strings.신들이 머물던 장소라 인간인 %s의 몸으로는 오래 버틸 수 없어요. 게다: Gods once dwelled there. Your human body couldn't withstand it for long, %s. And my power cannot reach you there.
strings.프뉴마는 제가 어떻게든 해볼게요. 가이아 님의 손길이 닿은 곳이니 제가: I'll find some way to help Pneuma. Gaia's touch remains there. There must be something I can do.
strings.(이리스가 손을 붙잡는 %s의 행동에 놀라 말을 이어가지 못한다.): (Iris stops short, surprised as %s takes her hand.)
strings.내 눈앞에서 그 신이 아르케를 지우려고 했다고. 내가 가야 해. 이리스,: That god tried to erase Arche right in front of me. I have to go. Iris, help me.
Arche's soul... Gaia cares so much for her...
strings.(이리스가 더는 안되겠다는 것처럼 한숨을 쉰다. 그리고 조용히 %s의 손: (Iris sighs as though she can object no longer. She quietly releases %s's hand and steps back.)
strings.정말이지, %s…. 저만큼 고집이 세시네요. 무웬이나 조에가 날 말렸을: Honestly, %s... You're every bit as stubborn as I am. Is this how Muwen and Zoe felt when they tried to stop me? Sigh...
I'm only saying that because I'm frustrated. I'm allowing it because it's Arche.
There won't be a next time. I'll tie you down somewhere by force if I have to.
strings.(이리스가 엘리시아라는 장소의 이름을 말하는 순간, 주위가 짙은 그림자로: (The moment Iris speaks the name Elysia, dense shadows begin to gather around them.)
strings.(그리고 그 사이로 프뉴마에서 그림자를 몰고 온 존재의 목소리가 들려온다: (The voice of the being that brought the shadows to Pneuma echoes from within them.)
strings.「성계신인 그대의 입에 엘리시아의 이름을 올렸군. 그렇다면 그대의 필멸자: 「You, a God of the Astral Realm, have spoken Elysia's name. Then I shall take your mortal.」
strings.(짙은 그림자가 점점 %s의 주위로 몰려온다. 그리고 언젠가 들었던 것: (The thick shadows close in around %s. Ominous, incomprehensible chants, somehow familiar, begin tormenting %s's ears.)
strings.「검은 달이 널 데려가리라.」: 「The black moon shall carry you away.」
strings.「검은 달이 널 붙잡으리라. 검은 달이 널 데려가리라.」: 「The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away.」
strings.「검은 달이 널 붙잡으리라. 검은 달이 널 데려가리라. 검은 달이 널 붙: 「The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away. The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away.」
strings.(얼마나 지났는지 알 수 없는 시간, 고통에 몸부림치던 %s의 귓가가 조: (After an unknowable stretch of agony, the sounds tormenting %s fade, and the darkness around them vanishes.)
strings.이리스? 이리스…. 이리스? 어디 있어?: Iris? Iris... Iris? Where are you?
strings.(거대한 달이 뜬 이상한 바다와 바다 위에 떠 있는 뒤틀린 나무, 끝이: (A strange sea beneath an enormous moon, twisted trees floating above the water, and a cliff with no bottom in sight. An utterly alien world fills the adventurer's vision.)
strings.정신 차리게. 안 그러면 이 밑으로 떨어져 다시는 올라오지 못하게 되니까: Mind yourself. Fall down there, and you'll never climb back up.
strings.(정신을 차리고 뒤로 물러나자, 갑옷을 입은 건장한 체격의 사내가 천천히: (As the adventurer regains their senses and steps back, a powerfully built man in armor slowly approaches.)
strings.(붉은 색 긴 머리와 수염, 그리고 갑옷. 마치 뜨거운 태양 같은 노년의: (With his long red hair, beard, and armor, the elderly man resembles a blazing sun. His expression is unreadable.)
strings.그분께서 자네를 데리고 오겠다고 말씀은 하셨지만, 진짜 올 줄은 몰랐네,: I was told you would be brought here, but I didn't think you would really come, %s.
strings.알다마다. 먼저 후손들의 어리석음에 대해 사과하겠네. 쥬드 왕국에서 있었: Of course. First, allow me to apologize for my descendants' foolishness. What happened in the Kingdom of Jude makes my blood boil...
The Kingdom of Jude...? Wait. Then you're...
I am Irfan of the Agni clan.
strings.(이르판의 소개와 함께 옆으로 불꽃을 머금은 기간트폴이 나타났다 사라진다: (As Irfan introduces himself, a flaming Gigant Pole appears beside him, then vanishes.)
strings.아슬란이 35대, 내가 6대니까. 시간이 그만큼 많이 흐른 게지. 날 기: Aslan is the thirty-fifth head. I was the sixth. That should tell you how much time has passed. There can't be anyone left who remembers me.
Still, it's a pleasure. It's been a long time since I saw one of the living.
strings.아직도 뭐가 뭔지 모르겠다는 표정이군. 내 손이 무안한데, 악수 좀 받아: You still look rather lost. You're leaving my hand hanging here. Would you shake it?
Thank you. I'm glad you're a polite young person.
strings.이르판 님, 질문이 있어요. 여기는 어딘가요? 그리고 방금 전에 산 자라: Irfan, I have a question. Where are we? And you just said "one of the living"...
strings.고대신들이 쉬기 위해 찾는 휴식의 장소였네. 에트와르를 사랑했던 그들이: It was a place where the ancient gods came to rest. Those gods loved Etoile, and while they stayed here, this place shone with their light.
strings.그런데 그들이 떠나거나 사라지면서 이곳도 빛을 잃었네. 보다시피 지금은: But as they departed or vanished, Elysia lost its light as well. As you can see, only the cold remains.
What do you think of Elysia as it is now...?
strings.(이르판이 물이 흐르는 낭떠러지를 바라보며 사색에 잠긴다.): (Irfan gazes thoughtfully at the water spilling over the precipice.)
Ah, I nearly forgot one of your questions.
strings.엘리시아는 신들의 방문에 제약을 두지 않아. 하지만, 다른 존재들은 죽어: Elysia places no restrictions on visits from gods. But other beings may come here after death. Like me.
strings.나는 죽어서 그분의 부름에 따라 이곳에 오게 됐네. 수명이 다해 가족들: I came here after I died, in answer to a summons. I had reached the end of my life and closed my eyes surrounded by family. Someone offered a hand to guide me. I took it, and found myself here.
strings.자네가 알고 있는 사람 중에 나와 비슷한 상태의 아이가 있지 않은가? 프: Don't you know a girl in much the same situation? Arche, in Pneuma.
strings.그분께서 그 아이를 미끼 삼아 자네를 부르셨던 것 알고 있네. 자네에게: I know my master used that girl as bait to summon you. There is something you are wanted for.
Whatever it is, this isn't the way to ask.
My master may do as they please. A god has that right.
strings.그런 말도 안 되는 소리 하지 마세요. 신이라고 해도 그럴 수는 없어요!: Don't say something so absurd. Even a god has no right to do this!!
strings.자네의 입장도 이해하네. 하지만 나는 그분의 일을 하는 몸. 나에게 뭐라: I understand how you feel. But I serve my master. No amount of complaining to me will change that.
strings.그리고 그분을 흉보는 건 이번 한번만 눈감아 주지. 만약 그렇지 않겠다면: And I will overlook your insults this once. If you persist...
strings.(이르판이 손을 뻗자 등 뒤에서 사라졌던 기간트폴이 나타나 그의 손에 들: (Irfan reaches out. The Gigant Pole that vanished behind him appears in his hand, and hidden flames burst forth to circle him.)
strings.자네가 세레스 님과 가이아 님, 그리고 새로운 성계신이 된 분의 사람이라: Even if you belong to Seres, Gaia, and the new God of the Astral Realm, I will reduce you to ash.
Overcome the trials as my master wishes, or be buried beneath them and disappear.
strings.(이르판의 손에 있던 기간트폴이 불꽃으로 변해 사라진다.): (The Gigant Pole in Irfan's hand turns to flame and vanishes.)
strings.먼저 자네의 힘이 어떤지 보고 싶군. 엘리시아를 돌아다니면서 다른 세계의: First, I want to see your strength. Travel through Elysia, face the beings from other worlds, and return.
strings.엘리시아가 다시 에트와르를 만나는 건 좋지만, 다른 세계에서 온 존재들까: It is good for Elysia to meet Etoile again. Less so for beings from other worlds to arrive as well.
strings.알겠어요. 그렇다면 제가 다시 돌아올 때, 뭘 어떻게 할지 알려주시는 거: All right. Then when I return, you'll tell me what I need to do?
Yes. I swear it in the names of Agni, the Sun God, and my master, ▒▒▒.
strings.(여전히 그 이름이 들리지 않아. 어쩔 수 없군.): (I still can't hear that name. Nothing I can do about it.)
Then I'll deal with them and come back, Irfan. Wait here.
strings.▒▒▒ 님께 초대받지 않은 자가 들어왔군. 일단은 조금 지켜볼까?: Someone has entered without an invitation from ▒▒▒. Shall I watch for a while?
Now tell me what I need to do.
You're impatient. I was just about to tell you.
Even lesser gods from other worlds must have been difficult opponents...
strings.엘리시아의 주인이신 ▒▒▒ 님께서 직접 문을 열어 이곳으로 부른 자들일세: The lord of Elysia, ▒▒▒, opened the gates personally and summoned them here.
strings.각자 자신의 세계에선 신이었을지 모르지만, 문을 넘어 이곳에 온 순간부터: They may have been gods in their own worlds, but the moment they crossed the threshold, they became subject to my master's will.
strings.왜 제가 그들과 싸워야 하는 거죠?: Why do I have to fight them?
strings.그게 그들의 일. 목적이 있기에 거래를 받아들인 것뿐일세. 나와 자네 같: That is their affair. They accepted the bargain because it served their purposes. It is beyond the understanding of mortals like you and me.
Accept it as a god's will.
strings.이곳에 들어온 이상, 그분의 뜻을 거스르지 말게. 자네가 이곳에서 할 수: Now that you've entered, do not defy my master. Overcoming the trials is the only thing you can do here.
Act on any foolish notions, and your worst fears will come to pass.
Calling it a god's will doesn't change the fact that you're threatening me.
strings.그러면 그 기대에 부응해드리죠. 어차피 할 수 있는 건 그것밖에 없다면서: Then I'll live up to those expectations. You said that's all I can do anyway.
You... have more spirit than is good for you.
strings.(엘리시아의 한 편, 멀리 달 모양의 돌이 커다란 바위 위에 박힌 채로: (In one corner of Elysia, a moon-shaped stone embedded in a large rock shines brightly in the distance.)
strings.왼쪽이 검은 달의 시련, 오른쪽이 대지의 시련이네. 먼저 검은 달의 시련: The Trial of the Black Moon is on the left. The Trial of the Earth is on the right. Enter the Trial of the Black Moon first.
strings.달 모양의 바위 앞에 서서 손을 뻗으면, 엘리시아의 힘이 자넬 인도할 걸: Stand before the moon-shaped stone and extend your hand. Elysia's power will guide you.
strings.(어차피 상식이 통하지 않는 존재에게 무슨 말을 해도 똑같겠지.): (There's no point arguing with someone who won't listen to reason.)
Once again, the Trial of the Black Moon comes first.
Wait here. I'll finish it and be right back.
strings.(이르판이 자신을 스쳐 지나가는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Irfan watches %s closely as they walk past him.)
An interesting one. To believe all gods are alike...
So those are our uninvited guests. Of all things, those stinking beasts...
strings.(달 모양의 바위 앞에 %s의 손이 닿은 순간, 어디선가 피어오른 그림자: (The moment %s touches the moon-shaped stone, shadows rise from nowhere and guide them to a new place.)
strings.(발을 내딛는 땅끝에서 느껴지는 따뜻함과는 달리 뒤로 보이는 끝없이 보이: (In contrast to the warmth beneath their feet at the edge of the land, the endless cosmos behind them feels colder than anywhere else.)
So this is where the trial begins... Everything feels so wrong. But those are...
strings.(멀리서 시련의 대상을 기다리고 있었던 것 같은 두 사람의 모습이 보인다: (Two figures wait in the distance, as though expecting the trial's challenger. One waves in friendly greeting.)
strings.어서 와, %s. ▒▒▒가 만든 네 시련은 어떤 것 같아?: Welcome, %s. What do you think of the trial ▒▒▒ made for you?
strings.카즈노, 남의 시련 안에 있다는 게 내키진 않지만, 이왕 하던 일을 마무: Kazno, I don't like being inside someone else's trial either. But if we're going to finish what we started, we don't have a choice.
You spoke last time. This time, I'll talk.
strings.그런데…, 저번이라니?: But... what do you mean, last time?
strings.기억하지 못하는 것 같네. 어쩔 수 없지. ▒▒▒가 널 이렇게 만든 걸: You don't seem to remember. Oh well. For ▒▒▒ to have done this to you, they must be furious.
strings.언제인지는 모르겠지만, 확실한 건 그 신 때문에 내가 여기 있다는 거죠…: I don't know when this happened, but one thing's certain. I'm here because of that god... Whether I remember it or not, that hasn't changed.
strings.그동안 너도 많이 변했군…. 네가 우리 같은 운명이었다면 어땠을까? 문득: You've changed quite a bit... What would you have been like if you'd shared our fate? I suddenly find myself wondering.
I was just about to stop.
strings.그래서 하고 싶은 이야기가 뭐죠?: So what did you want to tell me?
Ouroboros was born from a misinterpretation of Iris's will.
strings.우로보로스가 세계를 무로 돌리려고 해. 이건 마녀와 마족들이 하는 일과: It intends to return the world to nothingness. And that is by no means unrelated to what the witches and demons are doing.
That's why we're searching for traces of Ouroboros.
strings.아가슈라가 왜 우로보로스를 찾죠?: Why would Agasuras search for Ouroboros?
strings.우리도 이 세계가 사라지는 걸 원치 않거든. 이 세계가 존재해야 할 수: We don't want this world to disappear either. There are things we can only do while it still exists.
It may seem contradictory, but that's our nature. You know what we are. Sinners.
So we found our own ways to act for Iris's sake.
We made a deal with Shynic, one of the Champions who knew of traces left by Ouroboros.
strings.내 수명과 카즈노의 수명을 담보로 저주에서 벗어나게 해주겠다고 협조를 받: We secured her cooperation by promising to free her from her curse, staking my life and Kazno's on it. Then we pursued the serpent shadow, an avatar of Ouroboros.
You already know what happened with the serpent shadow.
We tried to seal the pact to lift Shynic's curse, but she refused. She said sinners were no fun, and she never wanted anything to do with us again.
strings.말은 그렇게 하지만, 샤이닉에겐 자신을 그렇게 만든 원흉이 모두 사라져서: That's what she said, anyway. I think it was because everyone responsible for what happened to her was gone.
strings.계약이 잘못되진 않겠지만, 누군가 페르세의 힘에 장난을 친다면 샤이닉이: The pact itself should hold, but if someone tampers with Perse's power, Shynic could lose control.
strings.뭐, 샤이닉은 샤이닉이고. 우리는 그 일 이후 우로보로스를 쫓는 일이 수: Well, Shynic can look after herself. Since then, tracking Ouroboros has become easier. We've even found bait to draw it out.
strings.우로보로스가 미끼를 물기 위해 모습을 드러내는 순간을 노리고 있지. 문제: We're waiting for the moment Ouroboros shows itself to take the bait. The problem is that the bait keeps running away. Hehe.
strings.그러면 이건 대답해 줄 수 있어요? 엘리시아엔 어떻게 온 거죠?: Then can you answer this? How did you get into Elysia?
Through Kazno's will and mine, you might say. Hehe. I hope that answers your question.
Let's go. We have work to do.
strings.그 미끼란 걸 찾으러 가는 건가요?: Are you going to find that bait?
%s, get these trials over with quickly. Then we can meet again later.
strings.(제릴과 카즈노가 말을 마치자 점점 깊어지는 어둠 사이, 목적지를 알 수: (Their words finished, Jeril and Kazno run into the deepening darkness, toward an unknown destination.)
strings.저 둘의 목적이 그런 거라니…. 후우, 일단 우로보로스가 잡히면 이리스가: So that's what those two are after... Sigh. If Ouroboros is caught, at least Iris will have one less thing to worry about.
Oh, there's no time to stand around.
strings.(눈앞에 보이던 어둠이 시련 안에 보이는 걸 잡아먹을 것처럼 점점 커진다: (The darkness ahead swells, as though about to devour everything within the trial.)
A trial made for me... Sigh. I don't understand. Let's just go.
strings.(다가오는 다른 세계의 존재들을 차례차례 쓰러뜨리고 도착한 막다른 곳,: (After defeating the approaching beings from other worlds one after another, %s reaches a dead end. An enormous black figure waits ahead, as if expecting them.)
strings.(%s의 모습을 본 검은 존재가 앞으로 나와 들고 있던 무기를 바닥에 내: (Spotting %s, the black figure steps forward and slams its weapon into the ground.)
strings.(잠시 후, 지진이 일어난 것처럼 세계가 흔들리기 시작한다.): (A moment later, the world begins shaking as though struck by an earthquake.)
strings.(토끼라고 하기엔 사람처럼 걸어 다니고, 몸집이 큰데다가 황금 건틀렛을: (It walks like a human and is far too large for an ordinary rabbit. Golden gauntlets grip an enormous hammer. The creature regards the adventurer with an otherworldly air.)
strings.토끼지만 토끼라 부르는 건 싫다고?: You're a rabbit, but you don't like being called one?
strings.그게 네 이름이야? 지금 건 인사한 거고?: That's your name? And that was your greeting?
strings.(잠깐…. 저건 아무 말도 하고 있지 않는데…. 왜 소리가 들리는 거 같: (Wait... It hasn't said a word... Why does it feel like I'm hearing a voice?)
strings.그래서 여기서 뭘 하고 싶은 건데?: So what do you want here?
strings.(안샤라가 미간을 찌푸리며 양손 해머를 %s에게 들어 보인다.): (Anshara frowns and raises its two-handed hammer toward %s.)
strings.다른 세계의 신? 이곳의 주인과 계약이란 걸 했고, 원하는 모습은 아니지: A god from another world? You made a contract with this place's ruler, and though this isn't the form you wanted, you're going to crush me as the contract requires?
strings.그리고 내가 신에게 감히 이런 태도를 보여서 화가 나셨다? 하지만, 어쩔: And you're angry that I dare speak to a god this way? Well, I can't help that.
strings.나는 내가 해야 할 일을 해야 하니까. 어?: I have things I need to do. Huh?
strings.(그 순간, 강력한 힘의 파장이 %s의 얼굴을 스치고 지나간다.): (At that moment, a powerful wave of energy grazes %s's face.)
strings.(잠시 후, %s의 볼이 찢기고, 그 사이로 피가 흐르기 시작한다.): (A cut opens across %s's cheek, and blood begins to flow.)
strings.이런 식으로 선전포고할 줄은 몰랐는데, 어쩔 수 없지. 나는 어떻게든 이: I didn't expect you to declare war quite like that, but so be it. I'll finish this trial, whatever it takes.
strings.너도 어차피 바라던 거 아니었어? 안샤라?: Isn't this what you wanted, Anshara?
strings.(안샤라의 눈과 마주치자마자 안샤라가 해머를 들고 빠른 속도로 돌진해온다: (The instant their eyes meet, Anshara charges forward at tremendous speed, hammer raised.)
Then let's do this. At least the god behind me is more trustworthy than you.
strings.(안샤라가 다시 한번 일어서지만, 건틀렛이 파괴되면서 쥐고 있던 황금색: (It rises once more, but its gauntlets shatter, and the golden hammer slips from its grip.)
strings.(그리고 그대로 주저앉아 힘을 잃은 듯, 천천히 빛을 잃어간다.): (Then it slumps to the ground, its light slowly fading as its strength drains away.)
strings.무시했던 인간에게 쓰러진 것이 억울했나 보네…. 쓰러지면서도 그렇게 시끄: You really can't stand losing to a human you looked down on... Making all that noise even as you fall...
strings.(주위를 잠식했던 불길한 그림자가 조금 전까지만 해도 안샤라였던 것을 그: (The ominous shadows encroaching on the area swallow what was Anshara only moments ago.)
strings.(이어 시련을 만들어낸 자의 목소리가 그림자 틈에서 흘러나온다.): (The voice of the trial's creator drifts from between the shadows.)
strings.「필멸자여. 다른 세계에서 온 하찮은 신이라 하더라도, 쉬운 상대는 아니: 「Mortal. Even a lesser god from another world must have been no easy opponent.」
strings.「그대 덕분에 안샤라의 힘은 엘리시아의 힘이 됐다. 이에 감사함을 표한다: 「Thanks to you, Anshara's power now belongs to Elysia. You have my gratitude.」
You used a god from another world to feed this place...
strings.됐어요. 듣고 싶지 않아요. 다음 시련을 끝낼 테니까, 아르케와 프뉴마를: No. I don't want to hear it. I'll finish the next trial. Then restore Arche and Pneuma.
strings.「원래 프뉴마를 건드릴 생각은 없었다만, 그대의 반응이 궁금했다. 그대란: 「I had no intention of touching Pneuma at first. But I grew curious about your reaction. You are a more entertaining mortal than I expected.」
It's been a while since anyone called me entertaining.
strings.「시련을 다 해결한다면 돌려주겠다. 그 아이도, 프뉴마도. 그러면 다음: 「Complete every trial, and I shall return them. Both the girl and Pneuma. Now prove yourself in the next trial, mortal.」
strings.(불길한 신이 남긴 경고를 끝으로 그림자가 사라진다. 그리고 그 사이로: (With that ominous god's final warning, the shadows vanish. A path that seems to lead outside appears between them.)
A path to the trial... I suppose I have to follow it.
strings.(눈을 감고 있던 이르판이 뭔가 느꼈는지 앞을 바라본다. 달 모양 비석: (Irfan opens his eyes, as though sensing something. When the adventurer slowly emerges from behind the moon-shaped stone, he smiles faintly.)
You look exhausted. Still, you've returned safely. That's what matters.
strings.화가 나는 것도 이해해. 내 말이 자네의 화를 더 돋우는 것도 알고 있고: I understand your anger. I know my words only make it worse. Even so, quietly proceed to the next trial...
strings.자네, 저 안에서 기다리고 있던 짐승들을 만났겠지?: You met the beasts waiting inside, didn't you?
strings.짐승들? 누굴 말씀하시는 건지 모르겠네요. 신을 가장한 토끼라면 만났지만: Beasts? I don't know who you mean. I did meet a rabbit pretending to be a god...
strings.(%s의 발 밑으로 어느새 이르판의 기간트폴에서 흘러나온 불꽃이 맴돌기: (Flames from Irfan's Gigant Pole begin circling %s's feet.)
strings.자네와는 어떤 인연이고, 어떤 이야기를 나눴지?: What is your connection to them, and what did you discuss?
We run into each other from time to time. They said they were looking for something.
strings.(이르판이 고개를 끄덕이자 %s의 발아래 있던 불꽃이 흔적도 없이 사라진: (Irfan nods, and the flames beneath %s's feet vanish without a trace.)
strings.초대받지 않은 짐승들이 뭔가 찾고 있는 걸 보면 중요한 일이겠지. 그들도: If those uninvited beasts are searching for something, it must be important. They know that too, I'm sure.
For beings born of the world's contradictions to take action...
strings.(이르판이 수염을 매만지던 중 엘리시아가 갑자기 흔들리기 시작한다.): (As Irfan strokes his beard, Elysia suddenly begins to shake.)
It seems we have another uninvited guest besides those beasts.
strings.초대받지 못한 존재들은 엘리시아에 올 수 없는 거 아닌가요?: I thought beings who weren't invited couldn't enter Elysia?
strings.그러게 말일세. 하하. 자네, 지금 이곳에 무슨 일이 일어나는지 궁금하지: So did I. Ha ha. Aren't you curious about what's happening here?
strings.그러면 엘리시아 한쪽에 비어있는 장소로 가보게. 자네의 인연이 어떻게 엮: Then visit the empty space in one corner of Elysia. You'll soon discover how your connections intertwine.
strings.(이르판이 불만 가득한 표정으로 발걸음을 옮기는 %s의 뒷모습을 조용히: (Irfan silently watches %s walk away, looking thoroughly displeased.)
strings.생각이 바뀌셨군요…. 다음은 어떻게 하실 겁니까?: You've changed your mind... What will you do next?
strings.(엘리시아를 탐색하다 나타난 길에 들어서는 순간, 짙은 어둠이 %s의 주: (The moment %s steps onto a path discovered while exploring Elysia, thick darkness spreads around them.)
strings.(마치 기다리고 있었던 것처럼…. 어떻게 하지? 분명 이건….): (As though it were waiting for me... What should I do? This has to be...)
strings.(잠시 상황을 살펴보고 있던 %s의 주위에 있던 어둠이 살짝 물러나자 누: (While %s pauses to assess the situation, the darkness recedes slightly, revealing a pair of bare feet.)
strings.(어둠이 점차 흩어져 가려져 있던 존재의 모습이 조금씩 드러난다.): (The darkness gradually disperses, revealing the figure concealed within it.)
strings.(빛을 잃은 세계의 중심에서 어둠을 품은 달처럼 빛나는 여성이 무표정으로: (At the heart of this lightless world, a woman shines like a moon harboring darkness. She studies %s's face without expression.)
strings.내 이름이 궁금한가?: You wish to know my name?
If you are so eager, I shall tell you.
strings.(여성이 손을 뻗어 굳어있는 %s의 얼굴을 어루만진다.): (The woman extends a hand and caresses %s's frozen face.)
strings.(그 순간, %s의 머릿속으로 누군가의 이름이 흘러 들어온다.): (At that instant, a name flows into %s's mind.)
Mortal. Speak the name that echoes within your mind.
strings.검은 달과 죽음, 그리고 밤을 기다리는 이들의 주인인 내가 누구냐고 물었: I asked you who I am. The mistress of the black moon, of death, and of those who await the night.
strings.(%s의 입에서 헤카테란 이름이 나오자 여성이 만족한 것 같은 미소를 짓: (When the name Hecate leaves %s's lips, the woman smiles in satisfaction. Then she seizes the mere mortal by the throat and hurls them away.)
No wonder your attitude angered Anshara.
strings.(헤카테가 힘겹게 일어나는 %s에게 다가가 손을 내민다. 하지만, 헤카테: (Hecate approaches %s as they struggle to rise and offers a hand. But the mortal, so foolish in her eyes, bats it aside.)
I understand your wishes. Then I shall change my judgment as well.
O mist of death rising from the black moon that blankets the earth.
strings.(헤카테의 주위에서 사라졌던 검은 그림자가 다시 피어오른다.): (The black shadows that had vanished rise around Hecate once more.)
strings.태초의 어둠이 삼킬 영혼이 여기 있으니 붙잡고 데려가라…, 나 헤카테의: Here is a soul for the primordial darkness to consume. Seize it and carry it away... in my name, Hecate...
strings.(그림자가 뱀처럼 변해 %s에게 다가가 목을 죄기 시작한다.): (The shadows become serpents, slithering toward %s and tightening around their throat.)
strings.(빛을 잃은 세계조차도 없었던 태초의 우주처럼 %s의 작은 세계조차 깊은: (Like the primordial cosmos before even this lightless world existed, %s's small world sinks into profound darkness.)
strings.(누군가 어둠의 늪에 빠져 아무것도 하지 못했던 %s에게 소리지른다.): (Someone shouts at %s, helpless in the swamp of darkness.)
strings.(짙은 어둠이 조금 흩어지자 힐다가 헤카테의 손목을 붙잡고 있는 것이 보: (The thick darkness parts slightly, revealing Hilda gripping Hecate's wrist.)
I didn't expect you to come all the way here, Hilda.
strings.(헤카테가 자신의 손을 붙잡고 있는 힐다를 보고 인상을 찡그린다.): (Hecate frowns at Hilda's hand on her wrist.)
If you're going to play games, know when to stop, Hecate.
You barge into my domain and dare address its mistress so carelessly...
strings.(힐다는 아무렇지도 않게 움직이네? 나는 아직도 발이 움직여지지 않는데…: (Hilda's moving as if nothing's wrong. I still can't move my feet...)
Release my hand. I will not tell you twice.
You know as well as I do that this is a foolish act of stubborn defiance.
I want to live. Let this person go.
Coming here must have taken resolve. And all for such a paltry reason...
strings.(헤카테가 힐다의 손을 뿌리치더니 뒤로 물러난다.): (Hecate shakes off Hilda's hand and steps back.)
strings.힐다, 이곳은 나의 세계, 엘리시아다. 네가 여기서 뭘 할 수 있을 거라: Hilda, this is my world. Elysia. What do you think you can accomplish here?
strings.가이아와 세레스의 사랑을 받은 그 아이, 그 아이가 아끼는 필멸자가 여기: That child is loved by Gaia and Seres. And it is my will that the mortal she cherishes should die here.
You should know that even you, a witch, can die in this place...
strings.(살아야 해, 여기서 나가서….): (I have to live. I have to get out of here...)
strings.신께서 하나는 알고 둘은 모르다니…. 밤을 쫓는 이들처럼 내 운명을 만든: A god who sees only half the picture... You're the one who shaped my fate, just like those who pursue the night. But...
Do you truly think I do not know?
If Ouroboros appears, the world you desire will...
Just let this person go. I'll handle the rest...
You propose a bargain? That is not how bargains are made. First...
strings.(헤카테가 조용히 한 곳을 응시하자 어둠 속에 가려져 보이지 않던 길이: (Hecate gazes silently at one spot. A path concealed by darkness appears, and a boy emerges from it.)
Well, this is awkward... I didn't expect to run into the Goddess of the Black Moon.
strings.(제릴이 볼을 살짝 긁으며 천천히 걸어나온다. ): (Jeril scratches his cheek and slowly steps forward.)
Why are you coming out of there, Jeril...?
strings.%s, 아까 이야기했던 거 잊었어? 우리는 우리대로 할 일이 있다고 했잖: %s, did you forget what I said earlier? We have our own work to do.
Work? What on earth are you trying to do...?
strings.(제릴이 아무렇지도 않은 듯이 헤카테를 지나 %s의 옆으로 다가가 상태를: (As though nothing is amiss, Jeril walks past Hecate to %s's side and examines their condition.)
strings.공포에 질려 움직이지 못하는 모험가는 오랜만이네. 하하. 내가 구해주고: It's been a while since I saw our adventurer too terrified to move. Ha ha. Even if I wanted to save you, this would be tricky.
Hilda, it's been a while. No need to be afraid. I'll take you away soon, so just wait.
strings.(그때, 헤카테의 발밑에서 검은색 덩굴이 솟아올라 빠른 속도로 제릴을 향: (At that moment, black vines burst from beneath Hecate's feet and hurtle toward Jeril.)
strings.(하지만, 그 자리에서 짐승의 포효가 울려 퍼지면서 다가오던 검은 덩굴은: (But a beast's roar rings out, stopping the advancing vines. They wither and retreat into the shadows.)
strings.검은 달의 신님. 날 너무 쉽게 생각한 거 아냐?: Goddess of the Black Moon, aren't you underestimating me?
I have nothing to say to a beast.
strings.세계가 위험에 빠졌을 때, 무력하게 갇힌 주제에…. 검은달의 신님도 레테: You were trapped and helpless when the world was in danger... You're as arrogant and foolish as Lethe, Goddess. How long will you keep this up?
strings.(상황을 살펴보고 있던 힐다가 다리에 힘이 풀렸는지 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Hilda's legs give way as she watches, and she sinks to the ground.)
strings.힐다? 힐다, 괜찮아요?: Hilda? Hilda, are you all right?
S-step back a little. I'm... dizzy...
strings.(헤카테가 힘들어하는 힐다의 모습에서 뭔가 알았는지 미소 짓는다.): (Hecate smiles, as though Hilda's distress has told her something.)
I see. Now I understand why you say you want to live.
%s, allow me to tell you a truth. You and Hilda are...
strings.(힐다가 목소리 높여 외치자 모두가 있던 장소가 조금씩 흔들리기 시작한다: (As Hilda shouts, the space around them begins to tremble.)
Wait, Hilda. If you do this now...
strings.(방금 전까지 없었던 녹색 빛의 창이 힐다의 손에서 벗어나 헤카테의 목을: (A spear of green light appears in Hilda's hand and flies toward Hecate's throat.)
strings.검은 달의 힘으로 움직이는 존재가 어디까지 거역할 셈이지?!: You exist through the black moon's power. How far do you intend to defy me?!
strings.(헤카테의 분노 가득한 목소리와 함께 다시 세계가 그림자로 가득 채워진다: (At Hecate's furious command, shadows flood the world again, as though erasing everyone who stood there moments before.)
strings.(그림자가 조금씩 물러나면서 엘리시아의 모습이 처음 발을 내디뎠을 때처럼: (The shadows gradually recede, restoring Elysia to the way it looked upon the adventurer's arrival.)
(Hilda and Jeril, who were arguing with Hecate only moments ago, are nowhere to be seen.)
strings.어디 간 거야? 헤카테가 대체 어떻게 한 거지…. 아, 몸도 다시 움직이: Where did they go? What did Hecate do...? Oh, I can move again...
strings.(언제 왔는지 시련의 문 근처에 있었던 이르판이 모습을 드러낸다.): (Irfan appears, though there is no telling when he left his post near the trial's gate.)
Lady Hecate has withdrawn... for now.
You look surprised. Yes, for now.
strings.헤카테 님의 뜻이 어떤지 나는 알 수 없지만, 그대에게 기회를 한번 더: I cannot know Lady Hecate's intentions, but she has chosen to give you another chance...
Attempt the remaining trial. The Trial of the Earth still awaits.
strings.갑자기 나타나서 죽이려고 하더니…, 또 기회요?: She appeared out of nowhere and tried to kill me... and now she's giving me another chance?
Such opportunities are rare. You should be grateful.
strings.(이런걸 나름 기회라고 생각하고 받아들여야 하는 건가…. 바르바토스나 레: (Am I supposed to accept this as some kind of opportunity...? Beings like Barbatos, Lethe, and Hecate think so differently from us.)
Rest here a while. When you're ready, return to the trial gates.
It takes time to recover after being crushed beneath a god's power.
strings.(이르판이 준비한 말을 모두 전달하고 시련의 입구가 있던 장소로 돌아간다: (Having delivered his message, Irfan returns to the trial entrances.)
He said that as though he'd experienced it himself.
I suppose I have no choice. I don't know this place, so I can only do as I'm told...
strings.(눈을 감고 뭔가를 생각하고 있던 이르판이 다가오는 %s의 기척에 눈을: (Irfan, lost in thought with his eyes closed, opens them at %s's approach.)
strings.신의 가호를 받아서 그런지 몰라도 엘리시아에서 회복하는 것이 빠른 것 같: Perhaps it's the gods' blessings, but you seem to recover quickly in Elysia.
strings.(몸이 가뿐하긴 하지만 그런 건 아닌 것 같은데….): (I do feel lighter, but I don't think that's why...)
strings.검은 달의 시련에 들어갔었던 것처럼 달 모양 바위 앞에 서서 다가가 손을: Just as with the Trial of the Black Moon, stand before the moon-shaped stone, approach it, and extend your hand.
It will guide you into the trial.
I'll overcome this one too, and return.
Confident as ever. Off you go, then.
strings.이 시련을 모두 해결하면 제가 엘리시아에서 할 수 있는 일은 모두 끝나나: Once I've completed every trial, will my business in Elysia be finished?
strings.내 시련이 아니라 확답을 줄 순 없네. 그래도 헤카테 님께서는 약속을 지: They aren't my trials, so I can't promise. Still, Lady Hecate will keep her word.
Though she could change her mind along the way...
strings.허허. 자네같이 신을 대하는 자는 처음이군. 내가 그렇게 경고를 했건만…: Heh heh. I've never met anyone who speaks of gods like you do. Despite all my warnings...
I was talking to myself. Pretend you didn't hear. I'll be going now.
The trial will hardly be enjoyable, but I wish you luck nonetheless.
strings.(별로 듣고 싶지 않은 응원이었어. ): (That's encouragement I could have done without.)
strings.(달 모양의 바위에 손이 닿은 순간, 어디선가 피어오른 그림자가 다시 새: (The moment the adventurer touches the moon-shaped stone, shadows rise from nowhere and carry them to another new place.)
strings.(적막한 언덕 위 거대한 바위에 새겨진 사람 얼굴이 아래를 내려다보고 있: (A human face carved into an enormous boulder gazes down from a desolate hill. Sharp thorn bushes fill the spaces between the slopes.)
strings.정신 똑바로 차리자, %s. 여기는 일반적인 장소가 아냐…. 그런데, 길: Keep your wits about you, %s. This is no ordinary place... And what's wrong with this path?
strings.(뾰족한 돌조각이 모여 만들어진 길 위로 날카로운 식물의 줄기가 놓여 있: (Sharp plant stems lie across a path formed from jagged stone fragments.)
So this is what you prepared for a trial...
strings.기분 나쁘게 저 바위 얼굴과 눈이 마주쳤네. 혹시 듣고 있나? 후우. 그: Ugh, I just met that stone face's eyes. Are you listening? Sigh. Then I'll say one thing.
You said you'd keep your promise. I'll trust you on that. Now...
strings.(원치 않는 시련이었지만, 받아들여 방법을 찾아 길을 헤맨 지 한참이 지: (Though the trial was unwanted, the adventurer accepts it and spends a long time seeking a way through, eventually reaching a dead end.)
strings.(멀리 아그니의 불꽃만큼 붉게 타오르는 횃불이 세워져 있다.): (A torch burns in the distance, as red as Agni's flames.)
strings.이제 여기서 뭘 하면 되는 거지?: What am I supposed to do here?
strings.(발걸음을 내딛는 순간, 끝에 세워져 있는 여성 모습의 석상이 하나 보인: (Taking another step, the adventurer notices a statue of a woman at the far end.)
strings.(피눈물을 흘리고 있는 것 같은 인상의 여성 셋이 한 몸인 상태로 횃불과: (Three women who seem to weep blood share a single body, bearing a torch, a key, and a dagger. The sight evokes something beyond mere revulsion.)
strings.(석상에 다가간 순간, 석상이 바람에 흔들리는 것처럼 덜그럭거린다.): (As the adventurer approaches, the statue rattles as though shaking in the wind.)
strings.(석상의 눈동자가 커지고, 굳게 닫혀 있던 입이 열린다. 입에서 흘러나오: (The statue's eyes widen and its tightly closed mouth opens. The sound pouring forth reaches %s's ears and begins tearing through their mind.)
strings.으으윽, 그만해…. 잠깐, 뭐라고? 지금 뭐라고 하는 거야?: Ugh, stop... Wait, what? What are you saying?
strings.(안샤라를 만났을 때처럼, 석상의 메시지가 자연스레 %s의 머릿속에서 퍼: (As when facing Anshara, the statue's message spreads through %s's mind as though perfectly comprehensible.)
strings.「죽음에서 돌아오는 것이 얼마나 어려운지 아느냐!!」: 「Do you know how hard it is to return from death?!」
strings.(키샤라라고 자신을 소개한 석상이 말할 때마다 알 수 없는 고통과 공포가: (Each time the statue calling itself Kishara speaks, inexplicable pain and terror wash over %s.)
strings.(귀를 막아야겠어. 뭐라도 막을 만한 게…. 어, 이건….): (I need to cover my ears. Anything I can use... Oh, this...)
strings.(모험가가 주머니에서 나온 오렌지색 리본에 놀라지만, 서둘러 리본을 잘라: (Surprised to find an orange ribbon in their pocket, the adventurer quickly cuts it up and plugs their ears.)
strings.(키샤라가 계속해서 알 수 없는 말을 쏟아내던 중에 조금씩 움직인다.): (Kishara continues pouring out incomprehensible words as it slowly begins to move.)
strings.「신을 보고도 무릎 꿇지 않는 오만함을 가졌구나. 」: 「Such arrogance, to stand before a god and not kneel.」
strings.(마치 서로 다른 인격이 떠드는 것처럼 말을 쏟아내던 키샤라가 갑자기 열: (Speaking as though several distinct personalities are quarreling, Kishara suddenly raises its key, torch, and dagger.)
strings.(서로 다른 키샤라가 정한 목표는 같았는지, 모두 같은 말을 외친다.): (The separate Kisharas seem to have chosen the same target. All cry out together.)
strings.『이 자리에서 널 죽이겠다!!』: 『We will kill you here and now!!』
strings.(커다란 충격과 함께 키샤라의 몸에서 파편이 튀어 올라 바닥에 꽂힌다.): (A tremendous impact sends fragments flying from Kishara's body and embedding themselves in the ground.)
strings.(석상의 머리 부분이 조금씩 갈라지더니 그대로 균형을 잃고 바닥으로 쓰러: (Cracks spread across the statue's heads. It loses its balance and topples to the ground.)
strings.(균형을 잃은 석상이 전체적으로 갈라지자 조금 전까지 조용했던 키샤라가: (As cracks spread through the fallen statue, Kishara, silent until now, begins speaking again.)
strings.「다시 살아날 수 있는 기회를 얻었는데….」: 「We had a chance to live again...」
strings.「처음부터 이 몸으로는 살아갈 수 없었어.」: 「We could never have lived in this body.」
I have nothing against you. But I have to finish this trial.
strings.「이미 알고 있었어. 도망간 신의 최후를….」: 「We already knew how a fleeing god would end...」
strings.「돌아올 자리는 없었잖아.」: 「There was no place left to return to.」
strings.「누군가 노래하던 것들이 사라졌다는 것도….」: 「And the things someone once sang of were gone...」
strings.『헤카테의 손을 잡는 건 아니었어. 헤카테를 가둔 건…, 헤카테가 가둔: 『We should never have taken Hecate's hand. What imprisoned Hecate... what Hecate imprisoned...』
(Pouring out cryptic words and a grotesque groan, Kishara hauls its fallen body upright once more.)
strings.『우리는, 키샤라는 이대로 쓰러질 수 없다. 죽어라!!』: 『We, Kishara, cannot fall like this. Die!!』
strings.(키샤라의 공격이 닿기도 전에 %s의 공격이 먼저 부서진 틈으로 들어간다: (Before Kishara's attack can land, %s strikes through a crack in its broken body.)
strings.『헤카테, 네 말대로 영겁의 시간 속에 묻혔다 깨어난 영혼을 취하면 될: 『Hecate, you said all we had to do was take the soul that awoke after being buried in ages of time...』
strings.(기괴한 비명과 함께 키샤라의 입이 닫히고, 파괴된 부분에 점점 더 금이: (With a hideous scream, Kishara's mouths close, and more cracks spread through the damaged statue.)
strings.(그리고 커다란 굉음과 함께 조금 전까지 키샤라였던 석상은 가루가 되어: (Then, with a thunderous crash, the statue that was Kishara crumbles to dust and scatters through the trial's space.)
It's getting darker. I suppose she's about to appear... Well...
strings.헤카테, 시련은 모두 끝났어. 당장 나와서 약속을 지켜!!: Hecate, the trials are over. Come out and keep your promise!!
strings.(시련 안에서 피어오른 그림자가 모든 걸 물들여 가고 있을 때, 어디선가: (As the shadows rising within the trial stain everything black, Hecate slowly steps out from somewhere.)
You succeeded again. Kishara's power, too, will have nourished Elysia.
strings.넣을 곳이 없어서 날 닮은 석상에 넣었는데, 그게 키샤라의 발을 묶은 모: I had nowhere else to put it, so I placed it in a statue of myself. That seems to have held Kishara back.
It clung to such misplaced hope.
I commend you for overcoming the trials. Well done, mortal.
I don't want your praise. Release Arche, Hilda, and Pneuma at once.
I truly dislike you, human, whom those children cherish.
You should know a god's word is never given lightly. Very well. I shall return them.
strings.(헤카테의 말과 함께 주위에 있던 그림자가 조금씩 물러나면서 그 밑으로: (At Hecate's words, the surrounding shadows withdraw, revealing Hilda lying beneath them.)
strings.(서둘러 힐다에게 다가가 부축하는 %s의 모습을 보던 헤카테가 조소를 보: (Hecate sneers as %s rushes to Hilda and helps her up.)
You have entertained me, mortal. Take Hilda and leave.
strings.힐다가 깨어난 순간부터 그대는 선택해야 할 것이다. 힐다의 영혼을 파괴해: The moment Hilda awakens, you will have to choose. Will you destroy her soul and take it for yourself? Or will your own soul crumble, leaving her to kill you?
strings.그대도, 힐다도 원하지 않았겠지만, 이미 영혼이 그런 운명 속에서 태어났: Neither you nor Hilda wished it, but your souls were born into that fate. All I can do is guide your soul, which the old man tampered with, toward death.
That's impossible. I would never do that. I am me...
strings.그런 말도 안되는 일이 나 같은 신에게도 일어나는데, %s 그대에게 일어: Such impossible things happen even to gods like me. There is nothing strange about their happening to you, %s. Your soul already belongs to more than you alone.
strings.여러 갈래의 시간 속에서 그대는 다른 모습으로 나타나기도 했고, 죽기도: Across the branching paths of time, you have appeared in other forms, and you have died.
strings.이리스, 그 아이가 네 저주를 손보는 것도 한계가 있을 것이다. 그대로: There is a limit to how much Iris can do to alter your curse. Perhaps accepting it and becoming a sinner would not be so bad.
strings.죽지 않으려고 발버둥 쳐봤자 결과는 같을 뿐이다. 필멸자여. 약간의 차이: Struggle against death all you like; the outcome is the same, mortal. The only small difference is who kills you.
Have not even the gods bound to Etoile died...?
Hehe. Don't be afraid. There is still so much amusement to come.
strings.내 힘으로 밤을 쫓는 마녀가 된 아이들, 그들이 할 일을 지켜봐다오, 필: Watch what the children who became witches through my power, who pursue the night, will do, mortal. To speak of it like this... I owe the sleeping Gaia an apology.
strings.(헤카테가 자신의 이름이 불리는 것이 마음에 들지 않는지 인상을 쓴다.): (Hecate frowns, displeased to hear her name shouted.)
strings.그대의 무례함을 봐주는 것은 오늘이 마지막이다. 그러면 필멸자여. 다시: Today is the last time I will tolerate your insolence. Until we meet again, mortal... do try to stay alive.
strings.(헤카테가 인사를 마지막으로 짙은 그림자 속에 몸을 숨긴다. 잠시 후,: (With those parting words, Hecate vanishes into the dense shadows. A moment later, the darkness filling the space rapidly dissipates.)
Why would that happen to me...?
strings.(눈을 뜨지 못한 힐다가 %s의 이름을 부르다 다시 정신을 잃는다.): (Unable to open her eyes, Hilda murmurs %s's name, then loses consciousness again.)
strings.제릴은 걱정하지 않아도 된다. 너는 바로 정령 세계를 확인해라. 이 마녀: Don't worry about Jeril. Go check on the spirit world at once. I'll take this witch...
strings.멈춰. 힐다가 우로보로스를 부르는 미끼라는 건 알고 있어. 그래서 데려가: Stop. I know Hilda is the bait to draw out Ouroboros. That's why you're taking her, isn't it?
strings.지금은 그럴 생각이 없다. 일단, 이리스에게 가면 지금 이 마녀는 살 수: I have no intention of doing that now. If we get her to Iris, this witch can survive.
Then that's all the more reason for me to take her.
strings.%s!! 정신 차려!! 지금은 내 말을 들어!!: %s!! Get hold of yourself!! Listen to me right now!!
strings.너를 위해서라도, 이리스를 위해서라도 내 말을 들으라고!!: For your own sake, and for Iris's, listen to me!!
strings.여길 벗어나 힐다가 눈을 떠 널 보는 순간, 누구 하나는 죽어. 그러니까: Once we're outside, the moment Hilda opens her eyes and sees you, one of you will die. So...
Unless you want to bring about the worst with your own hands, leave her to me for now.
strings.(카즈노가 체념하듯 대답하는 %s의 얼굴을 보다가 힐다를 부축한다.): (Kazno studies %s's resigned expression, then lifts Hilda up.)
strings.나중에 이리스에게 상의해라. 이 마녀의 거취를 어떻게 할지. 그리고 당분: Consult Iris later about what to do with this witch. And for now, I won't harm Hilda...
strings.(카즈노가 힐다를 부축하자마자 제자리에서 모습을 감춘다.): (The instant Kazno takes Hilda's weight, he vanishes from the spot.)
strings.힐다가 다시 돌아오긴 했지만, 그래도…. 프뉴마는 괜찮은 걸까? 아르케는: Hilda's back, at least, but still... Is Pneuma all right? Is Arche...?
strings.수고했네. 헤카테 님께서 내리신 이번 시련이 혹독하다고 생각했었는데, 자: Well done. I thought Lady Hecate's trials unusually harsh this time. Judging by your expression, I was right...
Lady Hecate has restored it. You needn't worry.
strings.역시 자네는 그분을 믿지 않는군. 원래 신이란 존재가 헤카테 님과 비슷할: You really don't trust her. Most gods are much like Lady Hecate, you know.
strings.자네가 모신 신들께서 위엄있는 모습을 보여주지 않으셨으니 그런 거겠지만…: Perhaps it's because the gods you serve haven't shown you their imposing side...
Sigh. Never mind. Follow me. Back to where we first met.
You may now come and go freely in Elysia.
strings.헤카테 님께서 자네의 출입을 허락하셨지. 다음부터는 프뉴마의 길을 따라서: Lady Hecate has granted you passage. Next time, follow the path from Pneuma.
strings.그리고 시련의 장소를 그대로 두신다고 하셨네. 강해지고 싶다면 똑같은 시: She also said she would leave the trials in place. If you wish to grow stronger, she thought repeating them might do you good.
After I barely managed to finish them, she wants me to do them again...
strings.신의 뜻을 제대로 받아들이지 않는 자네라서 자유롭게 하라고 배려를 해주신: Since you struggle to accept a god's will, she has graciously left the choice to you.
strings.자, 돌아가게. 프뉴마를 확인했다면 이리스 님께도 돌아가서 안부 전해주게: Now, go back. Once you've checked on Pneuma, return to Iris and let her know you're safe.
strings.(돌아가긴 할 건데…, 재촉하는 것 같은 기분은 뭐지….): (I am going... Why does it feel like he's hurrying me along...?)
Oh, next time, bring me some desert sand.
You sound very sure I'll be back...
strings.언젠가 내 과거의 이야기가 필요할 걸세. 그게 아니라도 헤카테 님께선 자: Someday, you'll need to hear about my past. Even if you don't, Lady Hecate looks forward to seeing you again.
Follow that circle of light, and you'll reach Pneuma.
Then I'll be going. See you again, Irfan.
strings.(%s의 모습이 사라지고 자리를 지키고 있던 이르판의 옆으로 헤카테가 다: (Once %s has disappeared, Hecate approaches Irfan, who remains at his post.)
You, once a mortal, ask after a god's well-being? Hmph... Well enough, it seems.
strings.아니라면 아닐 테고, 그렇다면 그렇다고도 할 수 있을 것이다. 지금 내: If I am not, then I am not. If I am, one might say I am. In my present circumstances, that is all I can say.
strings.알겠습니다. 그런데 내려가실 예정 아니셨습니까?: I understand. But weren't you planning to descend?
strings.아가슈라도 떠나고 지금 너와 나밖에 없는 엘리시아에 찾아오는 손님이 있어: The Agasuras have left, and Elysia holds only you and me. Yet another guest is coming... One I did not invite, of course...
(A black butterfly flutters in from somewhere, loses its light, and falls to the ground. A man slowly approaches and crushes it underfoot.)
Perhaps it's been too long, but this place feels terribly unfamiliar. Ah...
strings.검은 달의 주인을 오랜만에 뵙습니다. 친히 마중까지 나오실 줄은 몰랐는데: It has been a while, Mistress of the Black Moon. I didn't expect you to come out and greet me personally.
strings.이곳으로 오는 길을 찾아내다니. 어느 정도 돌아온 건가?: You found the way here. Have you regained some of what you lost?
strings.마족의 껍데기를 쓰고도 그대는 오래도 살아남았다. 판데모니움의 더러운 악: You have survived a long time in that demon's shell. Why come to Elysia? Why not keep wallowing with Pandemonium's filthy devils and demons?
strings.그런 검은 달의 신께선 다른 신들이 소멸할 때같이 소멸하시지, 굳이 갇혀: And why didn't the Goddess of the Black Moon vanish along with the other gods? You chose to spend all that time imprisoned instead, didn't you?
A filthy demon speaks far too freely.
We're both in the business of dirty work...
strings.(바르바토스가 손에 쥔 무기를 들어 헤카테를 겨눈다. 바르바토스 뒤를 따: (Barbatos raises his weapon toward Hecate. A boy who followed him in startles at the scene and hurriedly hides behind Irfan.)
strings.뭐, 뭐야? 대공은 여기 오자고 하더니 저 사람을 보자마자 사이 안 좋은: Wh-what? The grand duke told me to come here, then the moment he sees her, he makes it obvious they hate each other.
strings.대공이 헤카테 님을 소개해주겠다고 하던가?: Did the grand duke say he'd introduce you to Lady Hecate?
strings.그건 아니고, 죽고 싶지 않으면 따라오라고 했어. 그런데, 할배. 저 여: No. He told me to follow him if I didn't want to die. Hey, old man. Who is that woman?
strings.그냥 지켜보고 있거라. 우리 같은 인물들이 끼어들 여지 같은 건 없으니…: Just watch. This is no place for people like us to intervene...
strings.(헤카테가 조용히 손가락 끝으로 바르바토스의 대검을 밀어낸다.): (Hecate quietly pushes Barbatos's greatsword aside with a fingertip.)
Grand Duke, I have no reason to fight you.
strings.깨어나서 세계에 관여한 이상, 죽음을 각오하신 것 아닙니까?: Once you awoke and involved yourself in the world, surely you were prepared to die?
Is that how you see it, Grand Duke? It makes little difference to me.
strings.그동안 신들을 얼마나 베었지?: How many gods have you cut down?
Hehe. Who can say? Ask me something else. I'll answer just one question.
strings.(바르바토스가 대검을 거두고 안경을 고쳐 쓴다.): (Barbatos puts away his greatsword and adjusts his glasses.)
strings.그대는 성역에서 가이아를 벨 수 있는 충분한 시간이 있었다. 하지만, 그: You had ample time to cut down Gaia in the Sanctuary. Yet you did not.
strings.(헤카테의 말을 듣고 있던 바르바토스의 얼굴에 그림자가 깊게 드리운다.): (A deep shadow falls across Barbatos's face as he listens.)
strings.여기서 당신을 베면 그 질문에 대한 답이 좀 되겠습니까?: Would killing you here serve as an answer to that question?
strings.후후. 대공, 답하기 싫으면 하지 않아도 된다. 그대의 반응이 어떤지 보: Hehe. You needn't answer if you don't wish to, Grand Duke. I only wanted to see your reaction.
Now, I have a proposal for you...
strings.절망의 나락에서 기어 올라온 그대의 입맛에 맞을 것이다. 그러면 이야기를: It should suit the tastes of one who crawled up from the abyss of despair. Let us begin.
strings.(불안해 보이는 아르케가 %s의 모습을 보고는 서둘러 달려온다.): (An anxious-looking Arche spots %s and hurries over.)
I-I think so. Pneuma and the spirits are back to normal... I'm all...
strings.(아르케가 다리에 힘이 풀렸는지 그대로 주저앉는다. 놀란 모험가가 서둘러: (Arche's legs give way and she sinks to the ground. Alarmed, the adventurer quickly helps her up, but she cannot stop trembling.)
Arche... You're not all right at all...
strings.프뉴마에 오고 나서 이런 기분을 다시 느낄 거라곤 생각해본 적이 없는데…: I never thought I'd feel this way again after coming to Pneuma...
strings.영혼이 융합되지 못하고 떨어져 나왔을 때, 저는 공포를 느꼈어요. 다시: When my soul failed to merge and broke away, I felt terror. I hadn't felt such fear even when I was reborn...
strings.분명 아무 일도 일어나지 않은 것처럼 프뉴마는 원래의 모습을 되찾았지만…: Pneuma is back to normal, as though nothing happened... But just knowing a door to Elysia has opened...
I... I keep remembering things I never wanted to think about. It hurts...
I shouldn't be like this. Not when Gaia needs me...
strings.(불안해하는 아르케의 감정을 달래주려고 하는지, 애트모스 여럿이 다가와: (Several Atmos approach and circle Arche, as though trying to soothe her distress.)
strings.네…. 조금이지만요. 죄송해요. 프뉴마를 위해서 노력해주신 %s 님께 이: Yes... A little. I'm sorry, %s. After all you've done for Pneuma, you shouldn't have to see me like this...
It's all right, Arche. Get some rest.
strings.그럼 저는 이리스에게 가볼게요. 어, 아르케?: I'll go see Iris, then. Huh, Arche?
strings.%s 님이 돌아오시기 전에 이리스 님이 정령을 통해 제게 전하신 말씀이: Before you returned, %s, Iris sent me a message through the spirits.
strings.%s 님께서 구조하신 힐다라는 분은 괜찮다고요. 그리고 때가 될 때까지: That Hilda, the woman you rescued, is all right. And that you mustn't visit her until the time is right, %s.
It's because your souls have similar colors...
Then I suppose there's no helping it...
strings.(그러면 어떻게 해야 하는 거지…? 일단 기다려보는 수밖에 없나….): (What should I do now...? Is waiting my only option...?)
strings.헤카테는 제게 서로의 영혼을 다치게 하는 그런 운명이라고 했을 뿐인데,: Hecate only said we were fated to harm each other's souls. What do you mean, our souls are similar?
strings.아르케도 비슷한 영혼이 만나면 어떻게 되는지 알고 있었어요?: Did you already know what happens when similar souls meet?
strings.비밀은 아니에요. 제 입으로 이야기한들, %s 님에게는 제대로 들리지 않: It isn't a secret. But even if I told you, you wouldn't be able to hear it properly, %s.
strings.(맞아. 다른 사람의 입에서 아무리 듣는다 해도 신이 허락하지 않는다면: (That's right. No matter how often someone told me, I couldn't hear it without a god's permission...)
strings.이리스 님께서도 검은 달의 신이 말하면서 지금 아시게 됐으니까…. 죄송해: Iris only learned of it now, when the Goddess of the Black Moon spoke... I'm sorry I can't help...
It's all right. I'll wait until Iris calls me.
strings.저기, 아르케…. 프뉴마에서 잠시 쉬었다 가도 될까요?: Arche... May I rest in Pneuma for a while before I go?
Of course. Stay as long as you like.
Ever since the witches appeared, my mind's been in such turmoil...
strings.(프뉴마 하늘을 돌아다니던 아에루라 여럿이 깃털과 꽃잎을 날리며 %s에게: (Several Aerura drifting through Pneuma's sky float toward %s, scattering feathers and flower petals.)
strings.(이리스를 만나고, 이리스를 돕는 게 내가 해야 할 일이라고 생각했는데…: (I thought finding Iris and helping her was what I had to do... But there's more to it than that...)
strings.(복잡한 마음을 위로하듯 다가온 아에루라에게 몸을 기대는 순간, 방금까지: (The moment the adventurer leans against an Aerura that has approached as though to offer comfort, the anxiety from moments before melts away.)
strings.(그렇게 깊은 잠에 빠져든다. 다시는 깨고 싶지 않을 정도로.): (And so they sink into a deep sleep. So deep that they almost never want to wake.)
